text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I've finished changing, and my
legs feel
ready to race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The only thing left is to take home the
Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But of course. I'll show everyone why I'm
going to
be the number one favorite in
this year's Tiara
tour―

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I heard someone yelling something
about being
number one, so I figured it
was you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hate to break it to you, Miss Model
Student, but
this race is mine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well. Look who showed up
uninvited
just to mouth off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Save your breath for the race—because
you're
going down this time. I'll have you
running home
in disgrace.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Say what?! You trying to pick a fight?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are you upset about?! You're the one who came out swinging!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: 落ち着いて、レース前だぞ
落ち着いて、レース前だよ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Her strengths play toward the Tiara tour
races, so
I figured she might show up,
but... But!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like I need you to tell me that! I'm going
to wipe
the floor with her!
choice_data_list: レースで打ち負かしてこい
レースで打ち負かしておいで

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This is the start of my Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them all who's really number
one!
